name: Sarnadisc T
tagline: METAL WASHER FOR FIXING OF THERMAL INSULATION TO ROOF STRUCTURES
summary: Square, zinc plated steel washer with rounded edges for fixing thermal insulation to roof structures. Fastened with one fastener per washer. The flat surface makes it ideal for fastening thermal insulation beneath roof waterproofing membranes.
metaDescription: Square, zinc plated steel washer with rounded edges for fixing thermal insulation to roof structures. Fastened with one fastener per washer. The flat surface makes it ideal for fastening thermal insulation beneath roof waterproofing membranes.
attributes: Resistant to most common environmental influences
Ease of application in use with recommended setting tools
usage: Sarnadisc® T washer is used for mechanical fastening of thermal insulation in combination with appropriate Sarnafast ® Fastener. Only for fastening thermal insulation underneath roof waterproofing membranes. Sarnadisc® T washer shall not be used for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes. Suitable roofing system under 70% R.H. environment without chemical condition.
advantages: Resistant to most common environmental influences
Ease of application in use with recommended setting tools

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Product does not expire during correct storage.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions between + 5 °C and + 30 °C. Always refer to packaging. Do not stack pallets or any other material on top during transport or storage.

items.label: System structure
items.text: The following products must be considered for use depending on roof design: Sarnafast® 4.8 / 5.5 / 6.0 / 6.3.

items.label: Corrosion resistance
items.text:
Salt spray test | ≥ 1000 hours | GB/T 10125-2012
Kesternich test | ≥ 20 cycles | GB/T 9789-2008

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Sarnadisc® T washer must be installed in accordance with Sika application manual and installation instructions. Sarnadisc® T washer in combination with appropriate Sarnafast® Fastener is used for the mechanical fastening of thermal insulation. For more information look up the Product Data Sheet Sarnafast® Fastener
